textures.source: Original builtin ImageGen soft cephalopod albedo; bounded project bake and approximate luminance-derived microrelief, not measured skin depth

native_layout.scope: Eight positions/rotations/scales from actual MCP review export. New optimized original geometry adapter; not byte-identical to native tentacle_01 model. No native renderer/server connected.

source_tentacle_component.scope: Read-only catalogue prefab inspection. Only native layout fields drive the new optimized curved arm profile, not a byte-identical rendering of the prefab.

skin: Two linear bone influences per vertex, six bones per arm; entire suction cup shares its attachment weights
sucker_attachment: Ray intersection against actual LOD arm before6mm inset; sampled base-centre containment during animation
eyes: Horizontal pupil and original globe centred8mm inside each actual LOD head surface
scope: Première adaptation originale octopoïde encore stylisée : huit bras, ventouses creuses et ondulation locale. Raccords tête/manteau/bras, coutures UV visibles, ventouses anguleuses et bec simplifié restent à améliorer. Pas de photoréalisme final, collisions exhaustives, adhésion, tissu/forces, hydrodynamique, vitesse autoritaire, monde principal, serveur/réseau/VR ou FPS qualifiés.
